b.lede: Lawsuit also alleging pressure on hardware suppliers comes after Apple sued OpenAI for allegedly poaching employees OpenAI sued Apple on Friday, accusing the company of ⁠stealing its trade secrets ​and discouraging hardware suppliers from working on future OpenAI devices. The suit, filed in northern California federal court, comes after Apple sued OpenAI for allegedly poaching its employees to gain access
